correctness.rationale: Unique joint quadratic best responses and opinion fixed points are reconstructed. Weighted reversibility and the at-most-one-positive-eigenvalue property make centered action-neighbor-opinion covariance nonpositive; Nash unilateral inequalities make it nonnegative. Equality implies every action payoff discriminant vanishes and centered action lies in the kernel of the random walk. For complete multipartite graphs this is equivalent to equal cooperator fractions in every part, and it yields the stated exact enumeration. Direct exact-rational checks of 1,416 action profiles plus the K2,2 tie case passed; they do not prove the infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: The new implication is a complete if-and-only-if Nash classification and gcd-based enumeration in the homogeneous public-goods/opinion game on complete multipartite graphs. The source model establishes individual and unanimous-response results but explicitly leaves mixed-cooperation equilibria open; the 2023 prior coevolution paper uses a different neighbor-coordination action game. The classical one-positive-adjacency-eigenvalue property is attributed rather than claimed. Own existing claims on the same 2026 preprint concern periodic directed influence and global dynamical cycling, not this static Nash classification. Targeted mathematical-record and literature searches did not find a subsuming proposition; priority risks remain.

value.rationale: Mixed cooperator/defector equilibria and nonzero prejudice are explicit motivating gaps of the source model. The result classifies all sizes in a canonical connected multi-group network family, supplies a universal impossibility for gcd-one part sizes and an exceptional exact census otherwise, and distinguishes Nash ties from selected tie-to-defect dynamics. The conclusion is structural rather than a renamed direct substitution or finite numerical test.
